description: Trigger evals: queries that should and should not activate guide-renderer.
positive: Render the print-ready build guide for the stove shelf.
Make the master build document for the 4-ft bench.
Does this guide's cut diagram actually match the rip plan in the spec?
Check the rendered master against its design spec.
Why does this guide print with the figure split across two pages?
The cut-diagram legend prints as blank squares — fix the print CSS.
What scale is each figure in the cubby bench master drawn at?
Re-render the guides now that the spec was corrected.
negative: Design me a mudroom bench from scratch.
Does this cut list close on 36 inches?
How many sheets of plywood do I really need?
I cut the shelf 1/4 in short — how do I recover?
Update the shop inventory now that the build is done.
Add a new lesson to the lessons-learned file.
notes: Positives are requests to PRODUCE or CHECK a rendered master, or to fix how one prints. Negatives belong to build-planner (design), cut-verifier (arithmetic and yields), build-companion (bench-side recovery), or shop-close-out (knowledge updates). Note the boundary with cut-verifier: 'does the diagram match the rip_plan' is a rendering-fidelity question and belongs here; 'does the rip_plan close' is arithmetic and belongs there.
